overview: AI video generation becomes cheaper and longer with Google DeepMind’s Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash.
Australian universities partner with OpenAI to embed AI tools in curricula, preparing AI‑native graduates.
OpenAI launches GPT‑6 Cyber, a more capable and aligned model for vulnerability discovery and patching.

top.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
top.summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, enabling native 15‑second video creation, multi‑turn editing, and 30% lower cost ($0.07/s for 720p), improving consistency for professional video projects.

top.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
top.summary: Australian universities, including UNSW and Sydney, collaborate with OpenAI to give students access to advanced AI tools, integrating AI into coursework and research, and surveying strong student demand for AI skills.

top.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
top.summary: OpenAI introduced GPT‑6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model that outperforms GPT‑5.6 on exploit benchmarks, stays within researcher‑defined scope, and has already identified hundreds of vulnerabilities in Linux and Firefox.

top.title: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
top.summary: Airbnb announced plans to launch an AI‑native travel‑planning agent in early 2027, using a custom interface that assembles maps, photos, and itineraries rather than a traditional chatbot.

top.title: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
top.summary: NVIDIA released four open‑weight checkpoints for its Cosmos 3 Nano models, enabling multi‑sensor, multi‑view world simulation for robotics and autonomous‑driving research with commercial licensing.

top.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
top.summary: TechCrunch reports a researcher used OpenAI’s GPT‑5.6 model to discover a critical Ubuntu vulnerability, prompting OpenAI to roll out a dedicated cybersecurity model, ChatGPT Cyber, for high‑tier Daybreak Red users.
